title: castilleja inverta
intro: Castilleja inverta, commonly known as Indian paintbrush, is a plant species found in the western United States and Canada. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Castilleja inverta include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, reducing inflammation in the airways and promoting the clearance of mucus. The bioactive constituents of Castilleja inverta include iridoid glycosides, particularly castillejaine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
